## Outcome

Describe the business outcome and affected tenant/company/module scopes.

## Controls

- [ ] Permissions and scope are enforced by the backend.
- [ ] Posted records remain immutable and corrections are linked reversals.
- [ ] Ledger, stock, payment, audit, and outbox effects remain atomic.
- [ ] Retry/idempotency and concurrency behavior are covered.
- [ ] English and Swahili user-facing text are considered.
- [ ] No secret or restricted payload is logged or committed.

## Verification

List automated tests, reconciliation checks, migration checks, and any manual acceptance evidence.
